evidence.meaning: Total soil-layer water contains liquid above and below pwp plus ice; liquid soil-layer water contains both liquid fractions. Layered frozen water is their difference.
Native daily LAI is dimensionless; native daily potential evapotranspiration has already been multiplied by daytosec to give kg m-2 s-1.

limitations: Native text precision limits derived frozen-water precision.
LPJG and OpenIFS soil systems are independent; their outputs cannot form one vertically closed soil budget.
The source revision is recorded by the contemporaneous audit, not an embedded compiler manifest.
Received OpenIFS soil temperature has an optional respiration-response use in the checked source; layered T_soil output remains LPJG-generated. Verify useifssoiltemp for the specific run.
